hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT:-}" ]; then exec bash "$VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT/scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh"; fi; if [ -f scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh ]; then exec bash scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh; fi; if [ -f agent/scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh ]; then exec bash agent/scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh; fi'

bash -c 'if [ -n "${VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT:-}" ]; then exec bash "$VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT/scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh"; fi; if [ -f scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh ]; then exec bash scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh; fi; if [ -f agent/scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh ]; then exec bash agent/scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh; fi'

bash -c 'if [ -n "${VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT:-}" ]; then exec bash "$VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT/scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh"; fi; if [ -f scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh ]; then exec bash scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh; fi; if [ -f agent/scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh ]; then exec bash agent/scripts/hooks/post-tool-log.sh; fi'

bash -c 'if [ -n "${VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT:-}" ]; then exec bash "$VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT/scripts/hooks/pre-compact.sh"; fi; if [ -f scripts/hooks/pre-compact.sh ]; then exec bash scripts/hooks/pre-compact.sh; fi; if [ -f agent/scripts/hooks/pre-compact.sh ]; then exec bash agent/scripts/hooks/pre-compact.sh; fi'

bash -c 'if [ -n "${VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT:-}" ]; then exec bash "$VIGIL_AGENT_ROOT/scripts/hooks/session-end.sh"; fi; if [ -f scripts/hooks/session-end.sh ]; then exec bash scripts/hooks/session-end.sh; fi; if [ -f agent/scripts/hooks/session-end.sh ]; then exec bash agent/scripts/hooks/session-end.sh; fi'
